risks.risk: Demo artifact drift contaminates Cabina decisions
risks.description: Some Agile Agent Canvas artifacts still contain demo project names, owners, stacks, dates or assumptions that can mislead task planning.
risks.mitigation: Reconcile selected artifacts to Cabina identity, then add an anti-drift validator for forbidden demo identities.
risks.contingency: Quarantine unreconciled artifacts and exclude them from operational closeout until reviewed.
triggers: demo_identity appears in active canvas outputs
Demo owners appear in risks, readiness, retrospective or source tree

risks.risk: Canvas validator passes schema while semantic drift remains
risks.description: Current local canvas health checks parse JSON and basic artifact shape but do not block stale project identity or forbidden demo content.
risks.mitigation: Add a semantic identity validator for Agile Agent Canvas artifacts and include it in local readiness checks.
risks.contingency: Use manual rg checks before closeout until the validator is versioned.
triggers: Canvas schema health is PASS while demo terms remain
A reconciled artifact reintroduces demo_identity or demo_project_key

risks.risk: Live-gated stories are confused with local executable stories
risks.description: EPIC-4 contains Jira, OpenAI/Agents SDK live and Microsoft live gates. They must not be treated as executable local tasks.
risks.mitigation: Keep live stories in planned/gated state and require exact target, owner, rollback, postcheck, evidence and human gate before execution.
risks.contingency: Stop the affected substep with the exact gate state and continue local evidence work.
triggers: S-4.1, S-4.2 or S-4.3 is requested as execute_now without gate
A live action lacks target, owner, rollback or postcheck

risks.risk: Repo dirty state mixes unrelated local changes with canvas reconciliation
risks.description: The worktree already contains local changes in planning, VS Code settings and bridge files. Reconciliation must not revert or overwrite unrelated user/Codex changes.
risks.mitigation: Stage and rollback only explicit files for each carril. Report dirty state before closeout.
risks.contingency: Split into a dedicated codex branch/PR with explicit file set when the operator opens versioning.
triggers: git status shows unrelated files changed
a command attempts git add . or broad restore

risks.risk: Visual canvas focus differs from artifact truth
risks.description: VS Code Insiders can show JSON tabs or side panels while the canvas artifacts are valid. Visual state must be verified separately from file state.
risks.mitigation: Use command URIs and screenshots for visual activation, and local structured actions for artifact truth.
risks.contingency: Close with exact distinction between visual focus and validated artifact state.
triggers: Agile Canvas command opens an artifact JSON instead of the visual canvas
Screenshot does not show the expected lane although JSON validators pass
